purpose: Test whether changing the prose-generation process reduces actual-human AI smell without exposing the Phase377 diagnostic taxonomy to the generator and without sacrificing reader pull or clarity.

fresh_context_requirement.reason: This chat has already seen the AI-smell taxonomy and would contaminate a generator-isolation test.

process_only_protocol: Draft from one bounded viewpoint and that person's immediate private/social priorities.
Do not pre-plan a beat-by-beat clue or tension ladder.
Do not require every detail to pay an immediate plot function.
Do not consult or optimize against an AI-smell checklist while drafting.
Do not self-explain what the reader should infer after each piece of evidence.
Finish the first draft before any evaluation.
generator_must_not_see: Phase377 signature IDs or taxonomy text

post_draft_method: Separate evaluator applies Phase377 global diagnostic after both drafts are frozen.
Do not locally rewrite either draft before the first human comparison.
Blind CONTROL versus PROCESS labels before actual-human review.
Actual human judges AI smell separately from desire to continue, clarity, tension and skim point.
next_execution_step: Create a fixed fresh story/character facts packet and two fresh-context generator invocation files, then execute CONTROL and PROCESS in genuinely separate fresh contexts.
